annotation_policy.gold_construction: Explicit fixture assertions authored before running the tested pipeline; no parser, inference model, stored production response or boundary output generated these labels.
annotation_policy.real_video_requirement: Actual licensed/user-authorized pixels plus human-inspected frame annotations are required before claiming real-video semantic acceptance.
annotation_policy.metrics_limits: Authored semantic atoms test deterministic fixture alignment; text matching is only a literal proxy. Evidence-reference validity is structural, never proof that real pixels show a claimed fact.
annotation_policy.shot_count_policy: No fixed generated shot count. Mandatory same/different event constraints and allowed alternatives are scored separately.

inventory.asset_inventory_scope: Read-only backend/data and backend/eval-results snapshot, 2026-10-10; counts may include duplicates/caches. Local availability does not establish source license or human truth.
inventory.source_provenance_status: Local assets not promoted into gold; license/user authorization and human annotation need verification.
